headline: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina tie the knot in private ceremony
summary: The football superstar and his longtime partner exchanged vows in a civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, attended by their five children.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez have officially become husband and wife following a private civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, on Tuesday.
The couple shared the news via a joint Instagram post featuring matching gold wedding rings, which quickly garnered over a million likes.
The intimate event was attended by their five children, keeping with Georgina's preference for private celebrations over large parties.
The pair first met in 2016 at a Gucci shop in Madrid where Georgina worked, and they went public with their relationship a year later.
The couple shares a family of five children, including Alana Martina and Bella Esmeralda, and Ronaldo's sons Cristiano Jr, Mateo, and Eva.
The 41-year-old Al-Nassr star has previously hinted that he would marry after the 2026 World Cup, but the couple opted for a private union now.
Ronaldo has recently confirmed that the 2026 World Cup will be his final tournament, having already become the first player to score in six different World Cups.
caption:
Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez are officially married!

Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez have officially become husband and wife following a private civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, on Tuesday.

The couple shared the news via a joint Instagram post featuring matching gold wedding rings, which quickly garnered over a million likes.

The intimate event was attended by their five children, keeping with Georgina's preference for private celebrations over large parties.

The pair first met in 2016 at a Gucci shop in Madrid where Georgina worked, and they went public with their relationship a year later.

The couple shares a family of five children, including Alana Martina and Bella Esmeralda, and Ronaldo's sons Cristiano Jr, Mateo, and Eva.

The 41-year-old Al-Nassr star has previously hinted that he would marry after the 2026 World Cup, but the couple opted for a private union now.

Ronaldo has recently confirmed that the 2026 World Cup will be his final tournament, having already become the first player to score in six different World Cups.

headline_marked: At least 14 injured as [[Jubo Dal and Chhatra Dal clash]] in Dhaka’s New Market
headline: At least 14 injured as Jubo Dal and Chhatra Dal clash in Dhaka’s New Market
summary: The violence erupted over alleged extortion from footpath vendors and control of the area, leading to attacks with sticks and knives.
details: At least 14 people were injured during clashes between activists of the Jubo Dal’s New Market unit and members of the Chhatra Dal from Dhaka College on Tuesday evening.
The conflict began around 7:30 PM near Balaka Cinema Hall. Witnesses report that Jubo Dal activists attempted to collect money from footpath vendors, which was resisted by Chhatra Dal members.
The situation escalated into a violent confrontation, with a group of 40-50 people allegedly led by Jubo Dal leaders attacking students with sticks and knives.
Further clashes broke out near Priyangan Market in Bashundhara Goli after news of the initial attack spread, resulting in vandalism and widespread panic in the area.
Eight injured individuals from the Chhatra Dal side and six from the Jubo Dal side were identified. They were treated at Popular Hospital and later moved to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).
DMCH Police Camp In-charge Inspector Md Faruk stated that 14 people had arrived for treatment by 11:00 PM, noting that the number of injured could increase.
Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Ramna Division Deputy Commissioner Sheikh Zahidul Islam confirmed the clashes and stated that the situation was under control by 11:30 PM.
Police are currently investigating the incident and have vowed to take legal action against those involved.
caption:
14 injured in Dhaka's New Market as political wings clash over footpath extortion and area control.

At least 14 people were injured during clashes between activists of the Jubo Dal’s New Market unit and members of the Chhatra Dal from Dhaka College on Tuesday evening.

The conflict began around 7:30 PM near Balaka Cinema Hall. Witnesses report that Jubo Dal activists attempted to collect money from footpath vendors, which was resisted by Chhatra Dal members.

The situation escalated into a violent confrontation, with a group of 40-50 people allegedly led by Jubo Dal leaders attacking students with sticks and knives.

Further clashes broke out near Priyangan Market in Bashundhara Goli after news of the initial attack spread, resulting in vandalism and widespread panic in the area.

Eight injured individuals from the Chhatra Dal side and six from the Jubo Dal side were identified. They were treated at Popular Hospital and later moved to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).

DMCH Police Camp In-charge Inspector Md Faruk stated that 14 people had arrived for treatment by 11:00 PM, noting that the number of injured could increase.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Ramna Division Deputy Commissioner Sheikh Zahidul Islam confirmed the clashes and stated that the situation was under control by 11:30 PM.

Police are currently investigating the incident and have vowed to take legal action against those involved.
